results.title: Climate marchers plan pre-dawn gathering at Union Square ahead of UN week
results.content: Organizers say several thousand climate marchers will gather at Union Square Park on Tuesday, September 22, from 5:30 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., before walking up Park Avenue toward the United Nations for the opening of the General Assembly high-level week.
